name: condor10
label: Iron condor income sleeve (realistic ~6%/yr target)

sizing.basis: fraction of bankroll risked per trade (max-loss based)

calibration_sample: 50ETF 2015-02..2026-06, 135 monthly expiries, BS priced off QVIX
kelly_ceiling_note: Max achievable annualized CAGR at ANY sizing (flat+slippage): ~9% at 20-delta (maxDD -66%), ~11% at 25-delta (maxDD -75%). 10%/yr is NOT reachable at a sane drawdown; this sleeve sizes to a ~-35% MDD budget and accepts ~6%.
path_to_real_10pct: Only a timing edge (the macro_model VRP gate: sell only when implied vol >= model vol) could lift the per-trade edge enough for 10% at sane sizing. Needs a rebuilt IV-history backtest to validate (cached IV pickles are currently empty).
disclaimer: Analytics/suggestions only. Edge is thin and regime-dependent; past backtest is not a guarantee. No orders are placed.
